title: Intervallo VII: Mnestic Experience
wikitext:
'''Intervallo VII: Mnestic Experience''' is a side story released on June 11, 2026, alongside the Mnestic Experience event in Season 7. It is set in N Corp.'s District 14 and leads directly into [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing.

== Summary ==
The Sinners arrive in District 14 and team up with Ezra and Limbus Company's LCD department to track a Location-type Distortion. Clues from a developed film roll point to a Docugrapher, a photographer who shot buildings for N Corp.'s Canned Experience production and tested the limits of N Corp.'s ban on film. The case pulls Bamboo-hatted Kim into a Dungeon of the Fathoms shaped like S Corp., where he faces a projection of his old friend Im Gyeong-eop and his past failure to protect a councilor. Kim manifests E.G.O and the Distortion is resolved.

== Meursault's arrest ==
At the end of the chapter, N Corp. staff arrest [[Meursault]], naming him the former One Who Nails and a member of the [[Grand Magasin Sisyphe]]'s maintenance team who returned to District 14 after being exiled. [[Faust]] is troubled that she had not been told. A retrial is scheduled, which opens Canto X.
